title: Keto Ethiopian Cabbage Stew
description: A keto twist on traditional Ethiopian wot, made with tender cabbage and a tangy misir wot sauce. This flavorful stew is perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: Heat the clarified butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the glossy onions and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the misir wot paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the cranberries, Ethiopian spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Continue cooking the stew for another 10-15 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cranberries if desired.
